flows.name: 06-01 工作台：方案挂在左侧对话区（展开/收起 + 确认入口 + 窄栏不溢出）

steps.eval: (() => { planState.designPhase = 'PLAN_WAITING_CONFIRM'; planState.reportPlan = { id: 'plan_demo_left', revision: 1, topic: '机房能耗日报', requirements: { metrics: ['总耗电'], subject: '机房 A', timeRange: '最近 7 天', exclusions: [] }, sections: [ { id: 's_total', title: '总耗电概览', metricIntents: ['总耗电'], componentType: 'metric_card', displayIntent: 'total', selectionReason: '看总量，指标卡最直观' }, { id: 's_alarm', title: '当前告警列表', metricIntents: ['告警'], componentType: 'table', displayIntent: 'records', selectionReason: '看具体记录与属性，用表格', columns: [ { id: 'c1', label: '设备名称', fieldRef: 'alarm.device_name' }, { id: 'c2', label: '告警级别', fieldRef: 'alarm.level' } ] } ], assumptions: ['示意数据由系统生成，非真实业务数据'], suggestions: ['可加一个周对比趋势'], referenceTemplates: [] }; planState.busy = false; planState.error = null; renderPlanModule(); appendAiText('以下是方案'); return true; })()

(() => { const kids = Array.from(document.querySelector('#chat-scroll').children); const iPlan = kids.findIndex(el => el.hasAttribute('data-plan-bubble')); const iText = kids.findIndex(el => el.textContent.includes('以下是方案')); return iPlan >= 0 && iText >= 0 && iPlan > iText; })()
(() => { const col = document.querySelector('#chat-scroll').closest('section'); col.style.width = '340px'; col.style.maxWidth = '340px'; col.style.flex = '0 0 340px'; return true; })()

(() => { const root = document.querySelector('#plan-root'); const col = document.querySelector('#chat-scroll').closest('section'); const cb = col.getBoundingClientRect(); const rb = root.getBoundingClientRect(); const wide = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => el.getBoundingClientRect().right > cb.right + 1); return root.scrollWidth <= root.clientWidth + 1 && wide.length === 0 && rb.right <= cb.right + 1; })()
document.querySelector('#chat-scroll [data-plan-bubble] details summary').textContent.includes('查看已确认的文字方案')
